en: A sepia-toned postcard reproducing an old engraved certificate framed with ornate Baroque scrollwork. At the top center is a panoramic city view with a large fortress on a high rock above a river and a dense skyline of church spires and towers across the water. Two allegorical figures sit on clouds above the city. The lower half is filled with elaborate German Fraktur text resembling an 18th‑century guild or citizenship document, with signatures and a seal at the bottom. In the right margin, someone has handwritten "Ignaz Missb… (1782)" and there are small printed numbers/marks in the corners.
